# Feedback System

## Problem

There's no way for students to provide feedback about activities or for teachers to collect suggestions and complaints.

## Recommended Solution

Implement a feedback and suggestion system:

- Feedback submission form for users with:
  - Category selection (Bug Report, Feature Request, General Feedback, Complaint)
  - Subject/Title
  - Detailed description
  - Related activity (optional)
  - Anonymous option
- Admin feedback management panel:
  - View all feedback submissions
  - Filter by category and status
  - Mark as read/unread
  - Respond to feedback
  - Archive or delete old feedback
- Status tracking (New, In Review, Resolved, Archived)
- Email notifications for feedback responses

## Context

A feedback system will help improve the platform by gathering user input and addressing concerns. This creates a communication channel between students and administrators.
